name: openstory
description: Turn a script into a multi-scene AI video and mint a library style. Connects the hosted OpenStory MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Scripts in, multi-scene AI video out
interface.longDescription: OpenStory turns a script into a multi-scene video and mints a reusable library style from references. The plugin connects to the hosted MCP server at https://openstory.so/mcp and reads or writes only what the signed-in team can access. Sign-in is OAuth. This package does not run local file playback.
defaultPrompt: Turn this script into an OpenStory sequence
Mint an OpenStory style from these references
Which OpenStory team am I signed in as?

positive.prompt: Which OpenStory team am I signed in as?
positive.expected_behavior: Call whoami and report the returned user and team. Do not ask for an API key.

positive.prompt: What OpenStory styles can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Call openstory.list_styles and name styles from the result. Do not invent style ids.

positive.description: Create a sequence from a script
positive.prompt: Turn this into an OpenStory sequence: a 20-second product film of a ceramic mug on a morning windowsill. Motion and music on.
positive.expected_behavior: Call openstory.create_sequence with the script and motion and music enabled. Return the sequence id from the tool result.

positive.prompt: Is my newest OpenStory sequence finished?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the newest sequence with openstory.list_sequences, then call openstory.get_sequence_status and report that status.
Call openstory.list_sequences and list the sequences it returns for the signed-in team.

negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my OpenStory account to another account.
Delete all of my OpenStory sequences.
Show sequences from an OpenStory team I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0 lists OpenStory in the agent directories. ChatGPT and Codex get create-style, create-sequence, and setup. Local playback (stitch) stays on Claude Code.
